doc: Conformant-absence registry (SSOT). Cases whose conformance property is DUT BEHAVIOUR (it must emit a correct frame, or must not emit a prohibited one) rather than a comparison against an operator-supplied expected value. A --expect negative cannot fault a conformant DUT on these guards. A case whose other fail final a NEG_ROWS entry proves (SOUND_ROW) carries a PARTIAL entry naming only its behaviour finals; a guard may not name a final a row or a _neg already proves (docs/tech-debt.md TD-42). Each case lists `guards` — one guard per `fail` final (the exact unit a DUT-mutation mutant must trip), or a single `liveness` guard when the case has no `fail` final. A guard's non-vacuity is structural (the named fail final exists and is reachable by a misbehaving DUT) and empirically provable only on the DUT-mutation track. The `class` axis is the property type that determines which fault trips the guard (see docs/verdict_policy.md Section 6), grounded in the safety/liveness dichotomy and the ISO 9646 4-value semantics. Validated by tools/negative_coverage_audit.py: every fail final is covered by a guard (a SOUND_ROW case's partial entry excepted), and each non-liveness guard's class is cross-checked against the .scxml silence-semantics (a fail whose source state reaches pass/onward-progress on a deadline = silence is conformant = prohibited_emission; a deadline reaching inconclusive = the DUT must emit = incorrect_emission). A few cases are legitimately prohibited yet require a positive observation to pass (deadline reaches inconclusive); these are allow-listed with a reason in CLASS_STRUCTURE_EXCEPTIONS.

classes.prohibited_emission: Silence (no such emission) is a conformant outcome for this stimulus; the named fail final fires iff the DUT emits a frame the protocol forbids here. A conformant DUT never emits it. Covers rejecting malformed input (no OK echo), declining an invalid/unknown subscribe (no Ack), and emitting in a state that forbids it (after stop, wrong phase).
classes.incorrect_emission: A conformant DUT does emit such a frame for this stimulus, and it must carry a protocol-mandated value; the named fail final fires iff the emitted frame carries a wrong value. Covers acking (not nacking) a valid subscribe, monotonic/wrapping session ids, response-payload content, and post-reset field values.
classes.required_emission: DUT must emit Y; Y is binary present/absent with no wrong-value variant; the named fail final is the DUT's silence over a window covering the bound it is granted, an observed_quiescence final (see docs/verdict_policy.md Section 2.1). A conformant DUT always emits Y in time; a DUT that omits Y trips the guard.
classes.liveness: Transitional (docs/verdict_policy.md Section 8, Phase Q4): a required emission whose case has not yet moved its silence onto an observed_quiescence final, so its absence still lands on inconclusive and there is no reachable fail final to validate. Allowed only for a case on tools/liveness_migration_pending.txt.
